$schemaComment: Canonical Mahin design tokens. Feature code must not invent hex colors. Source of visual truth is docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md; this file is the machine-readable export used by Android, admin, and tests.

notes.typography: Persian typeface is selected in ADR 0004 (Vazirmatn, SIL OFL). Font files are not vendored in M0; M1 wires the licensed family into these roles.
notes.healthSemantics: Never use color as the only carrier of health meaning. Predicted vs recorded states must also use pattern, outline, iconography, or labels.
notes.darkHealth: Semantic health colors need contrast-validated dark variants before GA; do not invert light health colors blindly.
